scope: Artillery ammunition reachability before preference; pre-fire movement remains missing
finding: Fire chose strongest eligible HE (or smoke) before range. The preferred magazine could fail range and reject a battery without considering a reachable alternative.
implementation: ArtilleryAmmo optional finite ATL target filters each suitable available magazine by native inRangeOfArtillery before updating preference. Fire supplies reported target for automatic and explicit batteries. No-target API retains prior selection. Immutable classification cache never stores live range permission. Owner Shot still checks actual ammunition and current aim range.
sourceIntent: Protocol artillery uses available ammunition ETA and attempts pre-fire relocation when none reaches. Its unbounded movement wait, oracle target selection and unsafe multiple crew movement are not copied. This change fixes false range refusal only.
remainingGap: Actual out-of-range mobile battery pre-fire movement with original reported-fix age, magazine, route/crew/owner authority, finite deadline, physical arrival and fresh native range proof remains unimplemented. Post-fire Scoot is not equivalent.

validation.gates: HEMTT/FSM/full build and independent candidate verify passed

crewAuthorityFollowup.finding: Automatic first-match selection used living gunner only, while owner Shot later rejected incapacitation. A visibly unavailable first battery could mask an eligible later battery. Shot lacked explicit actual-gunner task/treatment/player/specialist availability at its two authority boundaries.
crewAuthorityFollowup.implementation: Server candidate and explicit admission use observable battery/gunner health, simulation, visibility and nonplayer/remote-control checks. Owner Shot independently requires current local actual gunner, protected-task availability, fire feature, no player/curator/specialist takeover before safety and again atomically before receipt/native fire.
crewAuthorityFollowup.limits: Server observations do not establish remote task state. No fallback dispatch after an uncertain native shot, owner reassignment or relocation added.
crewAuthorityFollowup.validation: 1477 tests, HEMTT/FSM/full build and independent verification passed

prefireExecutionAnalysis.established: getArtilleryETA operates on an actual artillery object, target and magazine; getArtilleryComputerSettings is player weapon UI data, not a hypothetical-position ballistic planner.
prefireExecutionAnalysis.sourceMechanism: Protocol fn_artillery attempts random 2500-3500m radius position about live target when every magazine ETA is negative, orders driver and commander, waits indefinitely for within120m/death then checks selected magazine ETA.
prefireExecutionAnalysis.currentOwnershipBoundary: Server ArtilleryFire currently rejects before token/registry creation when none of the eligible magazines reaches. ArtilleryMissionStep is a server fire FSM; CortexArtilleryScoot is post-fire owner movement. Neither already implements a pre-fire owner/arrival round trip.

implementationContract.server: Reserve exact original request, magazine and reported fix/time as a nonfiring mission phase; dispatch proposal to actual owner. No warning smoke, shot serial or spotter cooldown that implies fire before firing admission.
implementationContract.owner: Only an explicitly mobile artillery vehicle with current AI control seats and available movement intent may plan/issue. Static mortars cannot be treated as mobile. Use the existing group movement operation with current route receipt and original absolute deadline.
implementationContract.proposal: Use selected ammunition and geometric separation to rank finite supported destinations. Native ETA from current position can inform proposals, never establish future reachability. No ghost batteries, teleport, config maxRange-as-ballistics assumption or position swapping.
implementationContract.arrival: Require actual destination/floor proximity, current owner/crew/route/operation, selected ammo still available and fresh native inRangeOfArtillery/getArtilleryETA. An ended operation or accepted waypoint is not arrival.
implementationContract.handoff: Authenticated exact mission/owner/operation result returns to same server mission. A fresh fire admission then retains existing live target safety, warning, shot-serial and firing-event path.
implementationContract.interruption: New Zeus/mission order, external control, stale fix, owner change, missing crew, movement refusal or original expiry cancels/refuses without fire or replay. Migration may observe only exact surviving native leg; it cannot issue a second move or renew clocks.

prefireExecutionAnalysis.status: Pre-fire relocation remains unimplemented; analysis establishes required execution boundaries, not build-out or physical acceptance.
prefireExecutionAnalysis.scopeExclusion: Do not add a second driving controller, unbounded wait or generic per-battery polling worker.

movementAuthorityFollowup.finding: Existing Scoot session/group checks did not establish current availability/native task authority for both actual movement-control seats at route acquisition.
movementAuthorityFollowup.implementation: Snapshot actual driver/operator and authored receipt before geometry; require local available AI seats with no treatment/reservation/specialist control, enabled movement/path, no STOP or protected command. MOVE must still name current authored waypoint. Recheck before acquiring existing movement operation. No new movement worker or deadline policy.
movementAuthorityFollowup.clarification: Post-fire pending admission120s and separately started move120s are deliberate existing finite stages; server observer already retains pending deadline plus120. No unsupported claim that these are one renewed deadline.
limits: This is post-fire movement protection, not pre-fire relocation implementation.
Direct native intermediate MOVE goals may conservatively refuse rather than authorize takeover.
Original fire-request route continuity across the whole fire mission remains separate from this callback-local snapshot.
movementAuthorityFollowup.validation: 1477 tests, HEMTT/FSM/full build and independent verify passed
